text:
maya: Heads up — nightly CI is red for the integration matrix, multiple jobs failing with KMS decrypt errors. Seen ~20/24 shards fail with 'PermissionDenied: cryptoKeyDecrypt' (GitHub Actions runner).
ci-bot: [auto] workflow: nightly-integration #1298 failed on ubuntu-22; error summary: KMS decrypt failed for artifact key. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1298
samuel: Noted. Did anything change in IAM or key rotation window last night? @priya — you were touching KMS cleanup earlier, right?
priya: Yep, I cleaned up a few service account bindings on the project at 02:10 UTC as part of the least-privilege sweep. I intentionally removed a leftover `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` binding from `deployer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
maya: That aligns — the failure references that SA. Could that binding removal break decrypt for artifacts?
samuel: Yes — our deployer SA is used by a wrapper that re-encrypts secrets for runners. If it lost decrypt, Jobs that fetch secrets will fail. Priya, can you re-add the binding? Quick fix is to re-grant the role scoped to the key.
priya: On it. Adding back now. Command I used: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ci-kms-key --location=global --keyring=infra-keys --member=serviceAccount:deployer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
ci-admin: Re-run requested — kicking off a manual run for nightly-integration #1299. Will watch logs.
ops-bot: [audit] IAM change detected by priya at 2024-06-xxT02:10:23Z: removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for deployer-sa.
samuel: If the rebind doesn't help, we should consider rerunning only the failing shards to save time. Also request a bisect on infra-image changes if shard failures persist — last infra image bump to runner-image:v2.5 landed yesterday.
maya: Agreed. Priya — once you're done can you paste the exact IAM diff so we can pin the rollback window?
priya: Pasted diff: `- deployer-sa: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (removed)
+ deployer-sa: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter (added)` — I actually mis-typed the first removal; re-adding the correct role now.
ci-bot: Build #1299 started.
ci-admin: #1299 passed the decrypt step but then failed a flaky integration test in shard-7 (timeout). Not related to KMS anymore. Re-running shard-7 only.
samuel: Nice — sounds like the KMS issue was the root cause for the mass failures. I'll follow up with a short postmortem note and we should add a guard in the cleanup playbook to not remove KMS roles used by CI (or add a rollout window).
maya: Thanks everyone. Filing a quick tech debt ticket to add an automated check in the IAM cleanup runbook. :thumbsup:
priya: Sorry about the noise — will be more careful and put exceptions in the script.
maya: No worries; good catch and fast recovery.
ci-bot: [auto] thread closed after rebuilds succeeded.
